name: Build Dylib

on: [push]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Build Dylib
        run: |
          xcrun clang -dynamiclib \
            -isysroot $(xcrun --sdk iphoneos --show-sdk-path) \
            -arch arm64 \
            -o libcodaim.dylib \
            CodaimHook.m \
            -framework Foundation \
            -framework UIKit
          
      - name: Upload Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: dylib
          path: libcodaim.dylib
